sections.title: Overview
descriptions: This page brings together available employment and compensation records related to Joseph A. Nordin.

sections.title: Employment
descriptions: Officer Nordin began working for the American Fork Police Department on February 18, 2019.

Joseph A. Nordin works as an AFPD detective, and Suzanne M. Nordin works as a victim advocate. Although neither is in the other’s chain of command, their responsibilities could intersect if Detective Nordin investigates a case involving a victim whom Suzanne Nordin assists. This raises a question about how the department handles potential conflicts and preserves the independence of victim advocacy, particularly when another advocate is unavailable. The available information does not establish that a conflict occurred in any specific case.
